heroSubtitle: FliksLingo is a modern, gamified language learning platform built to celebrate linguistic diversity. We empower learners across the globe to speak authentically, appreciate rich traditions, and build lifelong fluency.

pillars.title: Gamified Habit Building
pillars.desc: Learning should never feel like a chore. With daily streaks, XP gains, dynamic quizzes, and interactive feedback, FliksLingo turns 10 minutes a day into lasting fluency.

pillars.title: Authentic Culture Vaults
pillars.desc: Languages are more than grammar. Every language on FliksLingo includes street slang, cultural proverbs, social etiquette, and regional idioms that bring each culture to life.

pillars.title: Global & African Inclusivity
pillars.desc: While most apps stop at European languages, FliksLingo gives African heritage languages—Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, and Nigerian Pidgin—the same first-class gamified treatment as Spanish or Japanese.

pillars.title: Rigorous Exam Simulation
pillars.desc: From official MCER (Spanish & French) and JLPT (Japanese) to HSK/CLEC (Mandarin), our Computer-Based Testing (CBT) engine tests your true retention with timed exam simulations.
